description_en: Creates one or more lifecycle hooks for a scaling group
description_zh: 为伸缩组创建一个或多个生命周期挂钩
kebab_example: aliyun ess create-lifecycle-hook --scaling-group-id asg-bp1eyv4qn8ssgv430000 --lifecycle-transition SCALE_OUT --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLifecycleHook

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the lifecycle hook. The name must be unique within the current scaling group. It must be 2 to 64 characters in length and start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

Default value: the value of LifecycleHookId
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩的名称。不能与当前伸缩组其他生命周期挂钩重名，长度为2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.）。

默认值为LifecycleHookId的值
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of scaling activity to which the lifecycle hook applies. Valid values:

SCALE_OUT: scale-out activities of the scaling group.
SCALE_IN: scale-in activities of the scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩适用的伸缩活动类型。取值范围：

SCALE_OUT：伸缩组弹性扩张活动。
SCALE_IN：伸缩组弹性收缩活动
parameters.name: lifecycle_transition

parameters.help_en:
The action to be performed after the wait state ends. Valid values:

CONTINUE: continues to respond to the scale-out or scale-in activity.
ABANDON: releases the ECS instances created during the scale-out activity or removes the ECS instances from the scaling group during the scale-in activity.
ROLLBACK: rejects the release of ECS instances and rolls back the scale-in activity. For a scale-out activity, this value releases the created ECS instances, which produces the same effect as `ABANDON`.

When a scale-in activity (SCALE_IN) occurs in the scaling group and multiple lifecycle hooks are triggered, if the `DefaultResult` of a lifecycle hook is set to `ABANDON` or `ROLLBACK` and the wait state of the hook ends, the wait states of other lifecycle hooks are ended in advance. In other cases, the action to be performed is determined by the last lifecycle hook whose wait state ends.

Default value: CONTINUE
parameters.help_zh:
等待状态结束后的下一步动作。取值范围：

CONTINUE：继续响应弹性扩张活动或者继续响应弹性收缩活动。
ABANDON：直接释放弹性扩张活动创建出来的ECS实例或者直接将弹性收缩活动中的ECS实例从伸缩组移除。
ROLLBACK：针对弹性收缩活动，会拒绝释放ECS实例，进行回滚；针对弹性扩张活动，会直接释放创建出来的ECS实例，效果同`ABANDON`一样。

当伸缩组发生弹性收缩活动（SCALE_IN）并触发多个生命周期挂钩时，如果一个生命周期挂钩的`DefaultResult`取值为`ABANDON`或`ROLLBACK`，且该挂钩等待状态结束时，会提前将其他生命周期挂钩对应的等待状态提前结束。其他情况下，下一步动作均以最后一个结束等待状态的下一步动作为准。

默认值：CONTINUE
parameters.name: default_result

parameters.help_en:
The wait time set by the lifecycle hook for the scaling activity. After the wait state times out, the next action is performed. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

After you create a lifecycle hook, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73846.html operation to extend the wait time of ECS instances, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73847.html operation to end the wait state of the scaling activity in advance.

Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩为伸缩组活动设置的等待时间，等待状态超时后会执行下一步动作。取值范围：30~21600，单位：秒。

创建了生命周期挂钩后，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73846.html延长ECS实例的等待时间，也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73847.html提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态。

默认值：600
parameters.name: heartbeat_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The notification message pushed to the `NotificationArn` (Notification Recipient) when the lifecycle hook pauses the scaling activity. This parameter is used to manage and tag different types of notification messages. You must also specify `NotificationArn`. The value of this parameter cannot exceed 4,096 characters in length.

If `NotificationArn` is set to an OOS template, including a public template or a custom template, `NotificationMetadata` must be specified as a JSON string that matches the parameters of the OOS template.

For example, in `{"dbInstanceId": "dds-bp17661e0135****", "modifyMode": "Append"}`, `dbInstanceId` and `modifyMode` are parameters defined in the OOS template. Some parameters in the OOS template have default values. You must specify the parameters that do not have default values in `NotificationMetadata`. If you specify a parameter that has a default value, the original default value is overwritten. However, keep the default values for the following parameters to obtain relevant information during the runtime of the scaling activity:

regionId: the region where the scaling activity is executed. Default value: ${regionId}.

instanceIds: the list of instances associated with the scaling activity. Default value: ${instanceIds}.

lifecycleHookId: the ID of the lifecycle hook. Default value: ${lifecycleHookId}.

lifecycleActionToken: the wait state identifier of the scaling activity, which is used to end the current suspended activity in advance. Default value: ${lifecycleActionToken}.

scalingGroupId: the ID of the scaling group to which the scaling activity belongs. Default value: ${scalingGroupId}.

lifecycleActionResult: the action to be performed after the wait state of the lifecycle hook ends. This parameter is used to end the current suspended activity in advance when the OOS template execution fails. When `DefaultResult` is set to `ROLLBACK`, the default value of this parameter is `ROLLBACK`. In other cases, the default value is `ABANDON`.
You can set the value of `lifecycleActionResult` as needed to overwrite the current default value. Valid values: ABANDON, CONTINUE, ROLLBACK, and ${lifecycleActionResult}. `${lifecycleActionResult}` indicates that the value of lifecycleActionResult is the same as the value of DefaultResult.
You can obtain detailed information about the parameters of the corresponding template in the OOS console (https://oos.console.aliyun.com/)
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩暂停伸缩活动时推送给`NotificationArn`（通知对象）的通知信息，便于管理和标记不同类别的通知信息。必须同时指定`NotificationArn`。参数长度不能超过4096个字符。

如果`NotificationArn`指定为OOS模板，包括公共模板或者自定义模板，则`NotificationMetadata`必须指定为JSON字符串，且与OOS模板的参数相符。

例如，`{"dbInstanceId": "dds-bp17661e0135****",  "modifyMode": "Append"}`，`dbInstanceId`和`modifyMode`为OOS模板中已定义的参数。OOS模板的部分参数有默认值，`NotificationMetadata`必须指定无默认值的参数，指定有默认值的参数时会覆盖原默认值，但以下参数请保持默认值，用于在伸缩活动运行时获取相关信息：

regionId：伸缩活动执行的地域，默认为${regionId}。

instanceIds：伸缩活动关联的实例列表，默认为${instanceIds}。

lifecycleHookId：生命周期挂钩ID，默认为${lifecycleHookId}。

lifecycleActionToken：伸缩活动的等待状态标识符，用于提前结束当前的挂起活动，默认为${lifecycleActionToken}。

scalingGroupId：伸缩活动所属的伸缩组ID，默认为${scalingGroupId}。

lifecycleActionResult：生命周期挂钩等待状态结束后的下一步动作，用于在OOS模板执行失败时提前结束当前的挂起活动，当`DefaultResult`为`ROLLBACK`时，参数值默认为`ROLLBACK`，其余情况默认为`ABANDON`。
您可以根据需要设置`lifecycleActionResult`的值来覆盖当前默认值，取值范围为ABANDON、CONTINUE、ROLLBACK、${lifecycleActionResult}。其中，`${lifecycleActionResult}`表示lifecycleActionResult的值和DefaultResult保持一致。
您可以在OOS控制台 (https://oos.console.aliyun.com/)获取对应模板的参数的详细信息
parameters.name: notification_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the notification recipient for the lifecycle hook. If this parameter is not specified, no notification is sent. If this parameter is specified, the following notification methods are supported:

MNS queue. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.
OOS template. Format: `acs:oos:{region-id}:{account-id}:template/{templatename}`.
EventBridge. Format: `acs:eventbridge:{region-id}:{account-id}:eventbus/default`.

The variables in the formats have the following meanings:

region-id: the ID of the region where the scaling group resides.
account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. The account ID of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user is not supported.
queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
topicname: the name of the MNS topic.
templatename: the name of the OOS template
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩通知对象标识符，不设置本参数表示不发送通知，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：

MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。
OOS模板，参数取值格式：`acs:oos:{region-id}:{account-id}:template/{templatename}`。
事件总线 ，参数取值格式：`acs:eventbridge:{region-id}:{account-id}:eventbus/default`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：

region-id：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID，不支持RAM用户的账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称。
templatename：OOS模板的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

LifecycleHookId.description_en: The ID of the lifecycle hook
